d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.definition: The date after which the food may no longer be safe to eat. It is a safety date and it is not negotiable.
d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.gloss: The date after which the food may no longer be safe to eat. It is a safety date and it is not negotiable.

d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.definition: 表示された日を過ぎると食べると安全でない可能性があり、品質期限ではなく食品衛生上の安全性を基準とした期限である。
d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.gloss: 食品を安全に食べられる期限。

d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.definition: 그 날짜가 지나면 음식이 안전하지 않을 수 있음을 나타내는 날짜이다. 품질과 관계없는 안전 기준이므로 임의로 연장할 수 없다.
d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.gloss: 음식을 먹어도 안전하지 않을 수 있는 최종 날짜.

d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.definition: Indica quando o alimento pode deixar de ser seguro para comer, e não se referee à sua qualidade. Essa data não deve ser ignorada.
d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.gloss: Data limite para consumir um alimento com segurança.

d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.definition: Tanggal ini menunjukkan batas keamanan makanan dan tidak dapat diabaikan jika makanan sudah kedaluwarsa.
d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.gloss: Tanggal batas setelahnya makanan tidak lagi aman dimakan.

d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.definition: วันที่หลังจากนั้นอาหารอาจไม่ปลอดภัยต่อการบริโภคและไม่ควรยืดอายุ เป็นกำหนดด้านความปลอดภัย จึงต่างจากวันที่บอกคุณภาพของอาหาร
d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.gloss: วันที่กำหนดสิ้นสุดด้านความปลอดภัยของอาหาร

d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.definition: Yiyeceğin güvenle yenilemeyeceği son tarih. Bu bir güvenlik tarihidir ve değiştirilemez.

d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.text: The use-by date was yesterday, so I threw the chicken away.
d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.translation: Son kullanma tarihi dündü, bu yüzden tavuğu attım.

d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.text: The use-by date was yesterday, so I threw the chicken away.
d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.translation: วันที่กำหนดสิ้นสุดด้านความปลอดภัยของไก่คือเมื่อวาน ผมจึงทิ้งไก่ไป

d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.text: The use-by date was yesterday, so I threw the chicken away.
d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.translation: Tanggal batas konsumsinya kemarin, jadi saya membuang ayam tersebut.

d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.text: The use-by date was yesterday, so I threw the chicken away.
d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.translation: A data de validade era ontem, então joguei o frango fora.

d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.text: The use-by date was yesterday, so I threw the chicken away.
The use-by date was yesterday, so I threw the chicken away.
d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.translation: 安全期限は昨日だったため、鶏肉は捨てました。

d31864fd6a83b478aba366cd638b853189c3336a.text: The use-by date was yesterday, so I threw the chicken away.

d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.definition: Doing a calculation in your head, without a calculator and without paper.
d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.gloss: Doing a calculation in your head, without a calculator and without paper.

d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.definition: 計算器や記録用の紙を一切使わずに、記憶の中で四則演算を行うこと。概数を求めたり、答えを確かめたりする。
d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.gloss: 電卓や紙を使わず、頭の中で計算すること。

d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.definition: 기본 연산을 빠르게 수행하여 대략적인 값이나 간단한 답을 구하는 계산 방식입니다. 복잡한 계산에서는 정확한 계산기로 확인해야 합니다.
d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.gloss: 계산기나 종이 없이 머릿속으로 계산하는 일입니다.

d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.definition: É resolver operações aritméticas apenas com o raciocínio e a memória. Pode ser usado para obter estimativas, fazer verificações ou resolver problemas simples.
d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.gloss: Cálculo mental é a realização de contas sem calculadora, papel ou outro apoio.

d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.definition: Perhitungan mental dilakukan di dalam kepala, biasanya dengan teknik pembulatan atau penghitungan bertahap. Hasilnya sering merupakan perkiraan kasar untuk pemeriksaan cepat.
d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.gloss: Perhitungan mental adalah calculations yang dilakukan tanpa kalkulator atau kertas.

d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.definition: การคิดเลขในหัวคือการคำนวณโดยไม่ใช้เครื่องคิดเลขและไม่เขียนบนกระดาษ อาจทำได้ทั้งคำนวณที่แน่นอนและค่าประมาณที่ใกล้เคียง
d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.gloss: การคำนวณโดยคิดอยู่ในหัว

d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.definition: Hesap makinesi veya kâğıt kullanmadan yapılan hesaplamadır. Aklı, hızlı bir yaklaşık sonuç veya küçük işlemler için kullanılır.

d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.translation: Zihinsel aritmetik bana yaklaşık sonucu verdi, denetim ise gerçek değeri gösterdi.
การคิดเลขในหัวทำให้ได้ตัวเลขโดยประมาณ ส่วนการตรวจสอบภายหลังให้คำตอบที่ถูกต้อง
Perhitungan mental memberikan angka kasar, sedangkan pemeriksaan kemudian memberikan hasil yang tepat.
O cálculo mental me deu um valor aproximado, e a verificação confirmou o resultado correto.
머릿속 계산으로 대략적인 수를 구한 뒤, 검산해 정확한 답을 확인했습니다.
暗算で概数を出し、検算で正しい答えを確認した。

d3461c3dda4316e3205dceda8643eeb6ea187fc0.text: Mental arithmetic gave me the rough figure, and the check gave me the right one.

d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.definition: The property of a set of axioms that do not contradict one another.
d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.gloss: The property of a set of axioms that do not contradict one another.

d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.definition: 하나의 명제 집합에 속한 명제들이 서로 논리적으로 모순되지 않는 성질이다. 모순이 없으면 그 명제들로부터 논리적으로 타당한 결론을 얻을 수 있다.
d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.gloss: 어떤 공리 집합의 명제들이 서로 모순되지 않는 성질이다.

d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.definition: Propriedade de um conjunto de axiomas ou regras em que nenhum deles contradiz os demais. Um conjunto inconsistente pode levar a qualquer conclusão, sem valor demonstrativo.
d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.gloss: Propriedade de um conjunto de axiomas que não se contradizem entre si.

d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.definition: Sifat suatu himpunan aksioma yang tidak saling bertentangan. Jika dua pernyataan dalam himpunan itu saling meniadakan, himpunan tersebut tidak konsisten.
d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.gloss: Sifat suatu himpunan aksioma yang tidak saling bertentangan.

d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.definition: คุณสมบัติของชุดบทสมมติฐานหรือกฎที่ไม่ขัดแย้งกัน หากข้อความสองข้อที่ต่างกันขัดแย้งกัน ชุดนั้นจะไม่สอดคล้องกัน
d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.gloss: คุณสมบัติของชุดบทสมมติฐานที่ไม่ขัดแย้งกัน

d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.definition: Bir aksiyom kümesinde hiçbir önermenin başka bir önermeyle çelişmemesi hâli. Çelişki varsa küme tutarlı değildir.
d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.gloss: Birbirleriyle çelişmeyen aksiyomlardan oluşan bir kümenin özelliği.

d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.definition: 一連の公理や規則の間で矛盾が生じないという性質。矛盾があれば、それらすべてを同時に真とはできない。
d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.gloss: 複数の公理や規則が互いに矛盾しない性質。

d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.translation: 二つの規則が同時に真でありえないなら、その規則の集合は整合的ではない。
İki kural aynı anda doğru olamaz; bu yüzden kural kümesi tutarlı değildir.
กฎสองข้อไม่อาจเป็นจริงพร้อมกันได้ ดังนั้นชุดกฎนี้จึงไม่สอดคล้องกัน
Kedua aturan itu tidak mungkin sama-sama benar, sehingga himpunan aturan tersebut tidak konsisten.
As duas regras não podem ser verdadeiras ao mesmo tempo, portanto o conjunto de regras não é consistente.
두 규칙이 동시에 참일 수 없으므로 그 규칙 집합은 일관적이지 않다.

d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.text: The two rules cannot both be true, so the set of rules is not consistent.
d388557c1d2430b0a291ed8aef1612f667cc93e4.translation: Hai quy tắc không thể cùng đúng, nên tập hợp các quy tắc đó không nhất quán.

d3a8eda4bbcfcd7865b6dfb355540727ca63290c.definition: Agreement produced not by open discussion but by arranging the information environment so one conclusion appears natural.
d3a8eda4bbcfcd7865b6dfb355540727ca63290c.gloss: Agreement produced not by open discussion but by arranging the information environment so one conclusion appears natural.
Sự đồng ý tạo ra không phải qua thảo luận cởi mở mà bằng cách sắp đặt môi trường thông tin sao cho một kết luận trông tự nhiên.

d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.definition: To put something that has thawed back into the freezer. For meat and fish this is a safety question, not a quality one.
d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.gloss: To put something that has thawed back into the freezer. For meat and fish this is a safety question, not a quality one.

d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.definition: 肉や魚では品質だけでなく食品衛生上の安全性が問題になるため、解凍した後に再冷凍できるとは限らない。
d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.gloss: 一度解凍したものを再び冷凍すること。

d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.definition: 해동한 음식을 다시 냉동하는 것을 말한다. 고기와 생선은 해동 후 재냉동하면 안전 문제가 생길 수 있으므로 신중해야 한다.
Em geral, alimentos descongelados não devem ser recongelados. Para carnes e peixes, essa decisão envolve segurança alimentar, e não apenas qualidade.
d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.gloss: Ato de colocar novamente no congelador um alimento que foi descongelado.

d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.definition: Makanan yang telah mencair dimasukkan kembali ke lemari es. Untuk daging dan ikan, hal ini merupakan persoalan keamanan, bukan hanya kualitas makanan.
d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.gloss: Proses membekukan kembali makanan yang telah mencair.

d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.definition: การนำอาหารหรือของที่เคยละลายหรืออุ่นขึ้นแล้วกลับไปแช่แข็ง สำหรับเนื้อและปลาต้องพิจารณาความปลอดภัยอย่างจริงจัง เพราะการแช่แข็งใหม่ไม่ได้ทำให้ปลอดภัยขึ้น
d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.gloss: การนำของที่ละลายแล้วกลับไปแช่แข็งอีกครั้ง

d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.definition: Çözülmüş bir şeyi yeniden dondurma işlemi. Et ve balık için bu, kalite değil güvenlik açısından önemlidir.
d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.gloss: Çözülmüş bir şeyi yeniden dondurma işlemi.

d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.text: You can freeze it now, but you cannot refreeze it once it has thawed.
d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.translation: Şimdi dondurabilirsiniz, ancak çözüldükten sonra yeniden dondurabilirsiniz.

d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.text: You can freeze it now, but you cannot refreeze it once it has thawed.
d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.translation: คุณแช่แข็งมันตอนนี้ได้ แต่เมื่อละลายแล้วห้ามแช่แข็งใหม่

d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.text: You can freeze it now, but you cannot refreeze it once it has thawed.
d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.translation: Daging itu masih dapat dibekukan, tetapi tidak dapat dibekukan kembali setelah mencair.

d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.text: You can freeze it now, but you cannot refreeze it once it has thawed.
d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.translation: O recongelamento do peixe foi arriscado porque ele já havia descongelado.

d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.text: You can freeze it now, but you cannot refreeze it once it has thawed.
d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.translation: 지금 냉동할 수는 있지만 한 번 해동한 뒤에는 다시 냉동할 수 없습니다.

d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.text: You can freeze it now, but you cannot refreeze it once it has thawed.
d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.translation: 今なら冷凍できますが、解凍した後は再冷凍できません。

d3da424a85938b50ac244d8db5cf52f174ee7e79.text: You can freeze it now, but you cannot refreeze it once it has thawed.
